scope: 48 supplied PDF/PPTX files in Organised/Organised, excluding course-admin maps and certificates. Physical covers, blanks, solutions and homework remain in numbering. DOCX and previously generated HTML companions are outside this page-numbered review.
method: SHA-256 matched to existing source IDs; new ID is src- plus first 12 checksum characters.
Confirmed presentation relationship order matches numeric slide order for all supplied PPTX files.
Read page-preserving extraction, with Italian/English OCR of sparse pages. Every page has an explicit reviewed topic assignment.

Viewed all 78 new Grammar_ A1.pptx slides in labeled contact sheets; detailed checks of tables and source inconsistencies. Also visually resolved all 34 older pages with insufficient OCR, distinguishing illustrations, activities, covers and video frames.
Practice uses original parallel scenarios. Repeated archive references share practice patterns; physical page coverage is not a count of unique grammar concepts.
Reference pages do not count as grammar mastery; needs-review pages cannot count as completed practice.

sourceCorrections.issue: Source prose confuses bello and quello after the noun; companion uses correct bello before/after patterns and separate demonstratives.
The source pronoun table prints quegli as a standalone demonstrative plural. Practice correctly uses quelli when the noun is omitted.
Intransitivity or movement alone does not determine the auxiliary. Practice teaches verb-specific pairs and includes ho camminato, ho dormito, sono arrivato/a.
Frequency-adverb positions in the source are common patterns, not universal obligatory positions.

limits: Original audio/video is not bundled or answered from guesses.
Some supplied classroom PDFs visibly include NotebookLM-generated notes; these are treated as supplied companion material, not independent authoritative grammar evidence.
No raw source pages, extracted text, private class names, answer keys or independent homework solutions are included.
All pages with insufficient OCR were visually classified. The remaining older pages were reviewed through extracted text/OCR, not a full visual proofread of every original slide.
The A2 roadmap is an overview; the supplied Course 3 lessons do not establish that all future course topics have been taught.
